items.title: Entry requirements - Thailand travel advice
items.description: Visa requirements You can visit Thailand for a period of 60 days for the purpose of tourism, business engagements, and urgent or ad-hoc work.
highlighted: You can visit Thailand for a period of 60 days

items.markdown:
UK citizens can visit Thailand for tourism or business without a visa for up to 60 days, provided they `complete the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) within 72 hours before arrival, hold a passport valid for at least 6 months, and show proof of onward travel`.[](https://www.thaiembassy.com/travel-to-thailand/travel-to-thailand-from-the-uk) [[1]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/travel-to-thailand/travel-to-thailand-from-the-uk)[[2]](https://www.kayak.co.uk/news/visa-for-thailand/)[[3]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/exemp-visa)

Entry and Visa Exemption Rules

- **Duration:** Up to 60 days per visit under the tourist exemption scheme (extendable once locally for 30 days).
- **Mandatory Arrival Card:** Must submit the online Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) within 3 days (72 hours) prior to arrival.
- **Passport Validity:** Must have at least 6 months remaining validity and a blank visa page upon entry.
- **Onward Travel:** Must show a confirmed return or onward flight ticket leaving Thailand within 60 days.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information)[[3]](https://cibtvisas.co.uk/thailand-visa)

When You Need a Visa in Advance

- **Longer Stays or Work:** Required for studying, working, business engagements exceeding short limits, or long stays.
- **Non-Standard Documents:** Holders of UK emergency or refugee travel documents must apply for a visa prior to travel.
- **Application Portal:** Processed digitally through the [Thai E-Visa Official Website](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/).

If you let me know your **exact length of stay** and **purpose of travel** (tourism, work, or study), I can tell you whether you need to apply for an advance e-visa or if the standard exemption is enough.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) Entry requirements - Thailand travel advice - GOV.UK Visa requirements.
